the self-consistent numerical model can be successfully used to study thermal runaway and filamentation effects in power bipolar transistors.
the thermal instability in a BJT array cell can be explained in terms of the current filamentation, which is a result of the distributed electrical effects.
the thermal instability and current filamentation phenomena are coupled in a complex way and the thermal runaway occurs in a time scale of a few microseconds in a 1 mm2 area power BJT array cell.

the numerical modeling and simulation of the thermal/electrical effects in power devices.

the development of numerical simulation techniques to model the transient behavior of a variety of devices.
